title: Review Response
description: Structure of .reviews/response.json — the reviewer's structured findings + per-finding fix status. Hand-crafted by the reviewer (or by the implementing agent on round N+1 reflecting fixes from round N).

review_id.description: Must match the handoff.json review_id this response is paired with.

responses.description: One entry per finding. New findings are appended as the round progresses; status flips when the implementing agent applies a fix.

^recheck_instructions_for_round_[0-9]+$.description: Instructions for the next round's recheck — keyed by target round number (e.g., recheck_instructions_for_round_3).

finding_id.description: Short stable id used to cross-reference (e.g., F1, F2, E2E-RACE).

severity.description: P0 / P1 / P2. Optional parenthetical context allowed (e.g., 'P0 (caught by live E2E, NOT in round-2)').

claim.description: The reviewer's full claim — what's broken and how they verified it.

fix_summary.description: Short prose description of the applied fix. Required when status=FIXED.

fix_locations.description: file:line refs for where the fix landed. Required when status=FIXED.

regression_tests.description: Test names or `path/to/test.sh — "<test description>"` references that pin the fix against regression.

rejection_reason.description: Required when status=REJECTED or WONT_FIX. Explain the disagreement or scope decision.
